title: Learner Safety Precheck — Domain E Seed Delivery Pool Assessment

LOW.description: No active learner harm — EW text is generic but not factually wrong

MEDIUM.description: Learner may see boilerplate feedback for incorrect answer; not harmful but degraded

HIGH.description: Learner may see incorrect or topic-unrelated EW text due to DL-016 rotation artifact

systemic_concerns.description: All 38 Domain E seeds are affected by the DL-016 ExplanationWrong rotation offset. The metadata block's ExplanationWrong fields describe the +1 neighbor's choices, not the current item's choices. A learner who answers incorrectly may see feedback about a completely different internal control topic.
systemic_concerns.mitigation: All EW remediation in S810 must be authored against the learner-facing content-block choices (Choices.A-D), NOT the metadata-block ChoiceA-D values.
systemic_concerns.blocking: None — offset is consistent (always +1), remediators are aware

systemic_concerns.description: 45 empty distractor ExplanationWrong slots across 38 seeds. When a learner selects the distractor whose slot is empty, no educational feedback is displayed. 8 of these are DL-013 boilerplate (generic text); 37 are genuinely empty.
systemic_concerns.mitigation: S810 Wave A+B targets 32 of 45 empty slots in 22 seeds.
systemic_concerns.blocking: None — empty is technically better than DL-013 boilerplate (no misinformation)

systemic_concerns.affected: 8 slots across 4 seeds (ED-016, ED-036, ED-046, ED-075)
systemic_concerns.description: 8 ExplanationWrong slots contain generic template text ('does not align with COSO... represents a plausible misconception'). Learners receive non-instructional feedback.
systemic_concerns.mitigation: S810 Wave C+D replaces all 8 boilerplate slots with choice-specific explanations.

systemic_concerns.description: Only 2.6% of seeds reference a COSO principle by number in ExplanationCorrect. Remediation should include explicit COSO principle citations.
systemic_concerns.mitigation: S810 remediation standard: each EW slot must reference the appropriate COSO principle.

top5_concerns.issue: High-priority seed (score 78) with DL-016 EW rotation. The learner may see feedback about EC-025's preventive/detective topic when answering EC-024. EW remediation must be authored against EC-024's content-block choices.
top5_concerns.recommended_action: Verify EC-024's learner-facing choices before authoring EW. Wave A, Batch A1 first item.

top5_concerns.issue: CONCEPT_OVERLAP with EC-014 (fraud triangle). The DL-016 offset may cause EW text from either ED-071 (change management) or ED-073 (monitoring exceptions) to appear on ED-072's answer choices.
top5_concerns.recommended_action: Cross-check EC-014 stem vs. ED-072 stem to confirm they test distinct fraud concepts before joint certification.

top5_concerns.issue: CC-discrepant seed (Step 0), MEDIUM safety tier, and cross-pack near-duplicate with ED-074. If CC is wrong, the learner has been seeing incorrect answer-key validation.
top5_concerns.recommended_action: Step 0 CC audit must resolve P1-EC-028 before any EW remediation. Independent recalculation required.

top5_concerns.issue: DL-013 boilerplate (1 slot) + 2 empty slots + Moderate-Easy difficulty. Lowest quality EC in the pool (184 chars). Learners receive boilerplate or blank feedback for 3 of 4 answer choices.
top5_concerns.recommended_action: Wave D priority. Consider whether ED-071 (same topic, better quality) should replace ED-036 as the seed.

top5_concerns.issue: Only UNIQUE seed (no cross-pack duplicate). DL-013 boilerplate + 2 empty slots. The unique topic gives it outsize value despite low score (50).
top5_concerns.recommended_action: Prioritize ED-046 over lower-score items with duplicate topics. Wave D, Batch D1.

certified_pool_impact.exposure: All 38 seeds are currently in the learner delivery pool with Certified status
certified_pool_impact.immediate_harm_assessment: No factual errors confirmed in current EW text, but: (a) 45 empty slots = no feedback for those answer choices, (b) 8 boilerplate slots = generic feedback, (c) DL-016 means feedback text may describe a different topic than the question being answered
certified_pool_impact.recommended_precautions: Until S810 remediation is complete, Domain E seeds should be flagged in the delivery mechanism as 'under review' with EW remediation pending. Learners should not be prevented from answering, but should see a note that enhanced explanations are in development.
